Mina (PM): Short sync: we need a clear rule for Dec vs Jan. Two pilots want SSO+quota. Team capacity is tight.

Omar (Eng): Infra items (autoscaler, KV cache) dominate. Estimate mismatch common; suggest +30% to infra estimates.

Priya (TPM): I'll run a 3-factor score: commercial weight, regression risk, rollout complexity. Quick CSV later today.

Sam (Sales): Sales note: PilotGamma will churn without SSO. Shim OK for them as long as quota follows in Jan.

Mina (PM): Proposal: bucket A/B/C by score. Add pilot bonus (+8) to commercial. Freeze new public APIs Nov 20. If A-bucket >80% capacity by Nov 25, keep Dec 15 ship; else reset to Jan 12.

Omar (Eng): Agree on freeze. Add feature-flag and telemetry tasks for any shim.

DesignBot: mock for SSO-shim delivered — 1 small consent screen + success/fail states.

Priya (TPM): Action items: Omar add +30% infra padding (Tue), Mina draft exec note (Wed), Sam align pilots (today).
